newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech BICS100 bond index falls 0.006 pts to 99.636.
newsitem.headline: Czech BICS100 bond index falls 0.006 pts to 99.636.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds fell 0.006 points in Friday's trading to 99.636, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.002 points to 2.305 years.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, fell 0.005 points to 95.806, the bank said, while the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.003 points to 2.398 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 rose 0.019 points to 1,193.065.
